text: Activation failed with ACT-500 after submitting activation request.
human_rationale: Explicit failure at activation stage; no evidence about trade or promotion.

text: Order has been pending for two days. Activation has not begun.
human_rationale: Current blockage is pending order; mentioning future activation is not an activation failure.

text: Customer traded in a device but the promised promo credit never appeared on bill.
human_rationale: Missing promotional credit is the current issue; trade-in and device are explicit context.

text: Monthly installment financing amount for the phone is incorrect. No promotion applies and no trade-in occurred.
human_rationale: Explicit device financing installment dispute with explicit negation of trade and promotion.

text: Customer reports an incorrect monthly bill. No further details are available.
human_rationale: Generic billing issue gives no evidence for promo or payment plan.

text: Device reboots repeatedly and cannot retain Wi-Fi connection.
human_rationale: Direct device malfunction; no evidence of account or financing problem.

text: Transfer/switch request failed with switch-service error SW-201.
human_rationale: Explicit switch-service error; business meaning of switch still needs SME sign-off.

text: Order was cleared, then activation failed with ACT-401.
human_rationale: Current failure is activation after order completed.

text: Trade-in was rejected due to damaged device. Customer was not offered any promotion.
human_rationale: Trade-in issue is explicit but no dedicated primary trade domain exists in draft; choose other pending taxonomy decision.

text: Customer qualifies for upgrade but promotion eligibility check incorrectly rejects the account.
human_rationale: Explicit promotion eligibility failure, not a financing plan problem.

text: New phone financing plan cannot be created at checkout.
human_rationale: Explicit failure to create an installment financing plan.

text: Device ordered and still awaiting shipping; customer says activation is broken but no activation was attempted.
human_rationale: Order not fulfilled; customer assertion does not establish an attempted activation failure.
